question_summary: Request approval to substitute PVC for the specified cast-iron roof drain leader per Section 22 14 00.
proposed_solution: Use PVC roof drain leader in lieu of the specified cast-iron leader, with equivalent performance and code listings.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: Material substitution for storm drainage piping requires approval by the plumbing engineer responsible for design compliance and code listings.
